name: BCII Enterprises Inc.
summary: BCII Enterprises Inc. focuses on authenticating and facilitating the settlement of NFTs (non-fungible tokens) that trade on various exchanges. The company was formerly known as Blockchain Industries, Inc. and changed its name to BCII Enterprises Inc. in July 2021. BCII Enterprises Inc. was founded in 1995 and is based in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
